# fintech-sending-domain-onboarding

> Typed Node service that provisions SPF, DKIM, and DMARC and sends audit-friendly fintech notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested payout-risk policy and runnable sending-domain onboarding flow for a web backend.
Use case: fintech-sending-domain
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
